title: Rapid-CNS2 pipeline parameters
description: Rapid-CNS2 Nextflow analysis pipeline for comprehensive genomic and epigenomic analysis of CNS tumours.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to input BAM file(s). Can be a single aligned BAM file, a directory with aligned BAMs, or a directory with unaligned BAMs.
input.help_text:
Accepted inputs:
- Single aligned BAM file: `/path/to/sample.bam`
- Directory with aligned BAMs: `/path/to/aligned_bams/`
- Directory with unaligned BAMs: `/path/to/unaligned_bams/`

id.description: Unique sample identifier used for naming output files and reports. Should be alphanumeric with no spaces.

outDir.description: Output directory for all pipeline results. Will be created if it doesn't exist.

tmpDir.description: Directory for temporary files. Auto-set to `${outDir}/tmp/` unless overridden.

patient.description: Patient name for reports. If not specified, uses the --id value.

reference_options.title: Reference and annotation paths
reference_options.description: System-specific paths to reference genomes and annotation databases. These must be configured for your installation.

ref.description: Path to hg38 reference genome FASTA file.

annotations.description: Path to annotation file for IGV reports (refGene.txt.gz).

resource_options.title: Resource parameters
resource_options.description: Control the number of threads allocated to individual analysis steps.

maxThreads.description: Maximum number of threads for general processes.

modkitThreads.description: Number of threads for modkit methylation calling.

cnvThreads.description: Number of threads for CNVpytor copy number analysis.

snifflesThreads.description: Number of threads for Sniffles2 structural variant calling.

snpThreads.description: Number of threads for SNV calling with DeepVariant.

svThreads.description: Number of threads for structural variant calling.

covThreads.description: Number of threads for coverage calculation with mosdepth.

methThreads.description: Number of threads for methylation classification.

mgmtThreads.description: Number of threads for MGMT promoter analysis.

analysis_options.title: Analysis parameters
analysis_options.description: Parameters controlling which analyses are run and their thresholds.

minimumMgmtCov.description: Minimum coverage threshold for MGMT promoter methylation analysis. If coverage is below this threshold, MGMT analysis will be skipped.

bamMinCoverage.description: Minimum coverage threshold for human variation workflow.

mnpFlex.description: Enable MNP-Flex classifier input preparation. Creates files needed for external MNP-Flex analysis at mnp-flex.org.

runHumanVariation.description: Enable wf-human-variation SNP and SV pipeline. Adds additional variant calling workflows.

container_options.title: Container and system parameters
container_options.description: Parameters for container engine and sequencer platform.

seq.description: Sequencer platform identifier. Auto-detected from BAM headers, but can be manually set.
